method.runs: One persistent interpreter per version per input per backend, pinned to logical CPU 3. Run both versions once to warm, starting with before. Seven timed calls for each version, alternating which version goes first in every pair. CPU pairs completed before the OpenCL pairs. Other host activity continued.
method.scope: Wall time from time.perf_counter() immediately before resolve(request) until it returns. JSON hashing, IPC, startup and input construction are outside the timed operation except creation of the small request dictionary. No tracing or profiler.
method.geometry_sha256: After every warm-up and timed run, SHA-256 of json.dumps([r[k] for k in ("charts","atlas","dual_complex","fan","root_families")], sort_keys=True, separators=(",",":")).encode(). Check equality across versions and against the other backend. Require certificate.chart_batch.backend to be the expected CPU or OpenCL backend on each call.
